title: Three bands of AI spend per employee, from Ramp’s data
intro: Move across the three groups of companies in TechCrunch’s 6 November 2026 report on Ramp’s card data. Each stop is what that group spends on AI per employee per month, as the article prints it, with the line the article gives about how that group moved this summer. The page does not compute a gap between the bands.
note: Every figure here is from TechCrunch’s article “Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO,” dated 6 November 2026, quoting Ramp’s lead economist Ara Kharazian. The figures are Ramp’s card data from its own customers, not the whole market, and not OpenAI’s or Anthropic’s revenue. The article gives ranges for the median and top 10 percent, and gives the top 1 percent as just below the $10,000 per employee they were hitting at their summer peaks. It does not print an exact August or September figure for that group. The overall growth figures are separate lines in the article: token spend grew 1.5 percent across August and September, 42 percent in July from the month before, and 8.9 percent from 23 September to 23 October. This control does not show those as a band.
